NBA DFS Rankings for Sunday, October 25 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, October 25 · 4 games · First game 7:00 PM ET · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 25, 12:31 PM ET

Cade Cunningham (DET) ranks first on the Sunday, October 25 DraftKings main slate at 52.7 projected DraftKings points for $9,500. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC, 48.1) and Tyrese Maxey (PHI, 45.6) are next.

The table ranks all 53 players in the run by SPAGS projection, with DraftKings salary and projected points per $1,000.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 25, 12:31 PM ET run of the Splash Play NBA model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are run, and NBA projections move with every injury report, so check the time above before you build.
